summary: Iter 194 — Frontend testing of (1) deep-link cold-load fix and (2) responsive on mobile/tablet/desktop. Deep-link fix WORKS: /travail and /vision-board cold-loads display the correct page (no inspiration overlay). Home '/' correctly still shows inspiration screen. NO horizontal overflow detected on any of the 6 pages [/, /vision-board, /travail, /croissance, /pilotage, /parametres] at 390px / 768px / 1280px. Desktop 1280px regression PASS: /vision-board shows Accueil + AI panel + Miroir dynamique with 'Mollie / Finance' node ('21 600 € encaissés ce mois'). HOWEVER: the Vision Board mobile-specific responsive assertions (vision-ai-panel stacked, accueil-score-business, accueil-linked-cards) FAIL because at width <= 768px, index.jsx replaces the entire page with VisionCanvaMobile (immersive canvas), so Accueil-based data-testids are not rendered on mobile/tablet.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile branch swaps to VisionCanvaMobile (immersive canvas) instead of rendering AccueilVision with the AI panel stacked below. Requested responsive behavior in review (panneau IA empilé sous le contenu, score-business 3 colonnes, linked-cards horizontal) is unreachable — those data-testids don't exist under 769px. Either the mobile branch should be removed / gated behind a toggle, or Accueil+AI panel need to be added to VisionCanvaMobile.

action_items: Decide product intent for Vision Board mobile: keep the immersive VisionCanvaMobile (then reviewer's spec is wrong) OR fallback to AccueilVision + stacked VisionBrainPanel on mobile so vision-ai-panel/accueil-score-business/accueil-linked-cards render under 769px.
If keeping immersive mobile canvas, update the review spec/testids expectations (or expose an alternate mobile Accueil route).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js L308-309: gating showInspiration/showPricing on location.pathname === '/' is correct and fixes the deep-link bug. Confirmed.

vision.css @media (max-width: 1023px) correctly stacks vb-main-row into column and clears .vbrain-panel sticky — good, but this only takes effect between 769–1023px because VisionBoardModule/index.jsx short-circuits to VisionCanvaMobile at <=768px. Consider raising useIsMobile threshold or removing the short-circuit.
test_credentials: thomas@zayado.fr (passwordless magic link, then localStorage.zayado_token+zayado_uid injected via addInitScript before goto for cold-load).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep-link fix (App.js isHome gating) verified working on /travail, /vision-board, and / at 1280px. Zero horizontal overflow detected on 6 pages x 3 breakpoints (390/768/1280). Main remaining issue: at width<=768px VisionBoardModule/index.jsx renders <VisionCanvaMobile/> and thus vision-ai-panel/accueil-score-business/accueil-linked-cards DO NOT EXIST on mobile — the requested 'AI panel stacked below content on mobile' cannot be validated until the mobile branch either uses AccueilVision or embeds the AI panel/score business into VisionCanvaMobile. Access token snippet used: request-link -> verify-link with thomas@zayado.fr.
rca of the issue: Root cause of missing mobile Accueil elements: /app/frontend/src/pages/VisionBoardModule/index.jsx lines 2203–2204: `const isMobile = useIsMobile(768); if (isMobile) return <VisionCanvaMobile />;`. This unconditionally replaces the responsive Accueil layout on mobile/small-tablet, bypassing the vb-main-row/vb-side-panel stacking that vision.css already prepares for <=1023px. Mitigation: remove the early return OR render AccueilVision + VisionBrainPanel *inside* VisionCanvaMobile below the canvas.
